relief carving on a large rectangular slab

justification: Both surfaces depict raptor-headed profile figures and animals in low relief on a rectangular slab, with a horizontal band dividing an upper register of repeated small elements from a larger scene below, which is the most specific correspondence. But A shows a single naturalistically modelled, anthropomorphic winged figure with detailed feathering, garment and a bucket-like handled object flanked by symmetrical stylised plants, while B shows a schematic, outline-drawn assemblage of quadrupeds, a squatting figure, a row of heads and a bird-headed creature with no plants, no wings and no shared narrative relationship.
